CLASSIC RULES

- If you miss all throws you go to 5 meters next time.
- If you make 1 successful throw you go to 6 meters.
- If you make 2 successful throws you go to 7 meters
- And so forth...
- Points are given for every successful throw matching the number of meters you throw from.
- Every successful 5 meter throw gives 5 points.
- Every successful 6 meter throw gives 6 points.
- And so forth...
- Once all rounds (5, 10 or 20) have been played the player with most points will be the winner.

ROUND-THE-CLOCK RULES
- Play 1-6 players
- Mark up distances 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 meters in a circle around the basket.
- Each player picks 5 preferably similar putters.
- All players go to their individual start distance. First player 5m, second 6m etc.
- All players tries to make a many putts as possible with their own 5 discs.
- 2 points are given for every successful throw and 1 point for every metal throw - NO matter the distance.
- Collect all discs and rotate clock-wise to new distances as indicated in the app.
- Repeat for 6 rounds.
- Once all rounds (always 6) have been played the player with most points will be the winner.

The 'YO YO Endurance Test' provides an important instrument for determining the level of physical efficiency of an athlete.
The physical capacity is evaluated quickly and easily by placing two cones spaced 20 meters each other.
The athlete has to run at full speed from one cone to another and then return again on the first cone. This path must be repeated for six times without any break, and get  the split times every time the athlete passes on the first cone.

This application will track all the split time and at the end will be calculated two parameters that determine the outcome of the test. More these values are low and better will be the athlete's performance.

Basically the final result is given by a mathematical formula that processes the delta between the averages of the last two split times and the first two split times  and thereby the athlete's ability to maintain its maximum speed for a certain period of time.

The second value obtained on completion of the test, is the first result considering also the total time of the test.
